Its 10 direct nav-exposed children (New Furniture, New Outdoor Living, New Tabletop & Bar, New Kitchen, New Bedding, New Bath, New Decor, New Pillows & Throws, New Rugs, New Lighting) were confirmed as genuine, deliberately-labelled site taxonomy via the primary-navigation mega-menu markup itself (each has its own data-name breadcrumb string, e.g. 'crate core>Furniture>New Furniture>New Furniture'), but the block hit before any of the 10 could be opened to read an exact count, so they carry qty:null and a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than a fabricated number.
notes: Access: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow; used curl_cffi TLS impersonation per prior pass notes. Main New Arrivals PLP found via the site's own primary nav: the 'New' mega-menu's parent link is id="Nav_Nav_WhatsNew_AllNewArrivals", data-name 'crate core > new > fall 2026 new Arrivals' (also seen as 'crate core > new > 1500+ new fall arrivals'), href /whats-new/new-arrivals-by-category/1. Opening the hub form of that URL (/whats-new/new-arrivals-by-category/, which loaded successfully where the /1-suffixed form was blocked) confirmed: h1 'New Arrivals', <title>New Arrivals by Category | Crate & Barrel</title>, data-num-results/totalCount=2430 - a genuine, actively-merchandised main New Arrivals PLP, not an editorial/lookbook page. The mega-menu itself enumerates 10 direct children (each with its own nav data-name breadcrumb, confirming deliberate site taxonomy rather than an invented grouping): New Furniture -> /whats-new/new-arrivals-furniture/1, New Outdoor Living -> /whats-new/new-arrivals-outdoor-living/1, New Tabletop & Bar -> /whats-new/new-arrivals-tabletop/1, New Kitchen -> /whats-new/new-arrivals-kitchen/, New Bedding -> /whats-new/new-arrivals-bedding-bath/1, New Bath -> /whats-new/new-arrivals-bath/1, New Decor -> /whats-new/new-arrivals-decor/1, New Pillows & Throws -> /whats-new/new-arrivals-pillows/1, New Rugs -> /whats-new/new-arrivals-rugs/1, New Lighting -> /whats-new/new-arrivals-lighting/1 - none of these could be opened before the block, so none carry a qty. New Kitchen itself has a further nav-exposed sub-tier (new-arrivals-cutlery, -electrics-appliances, -cookware, -bakeware, -kitchen-textiles, -kitchen-tools-accessories) seen only in the PLP sitemap - not added as rows (third-level depth, unverified, left for a follow-up pass). /whats-new/new-items/1 opened and returned a DIFFERENT page from the main-site hub: data-num-results/totalCount=840, but <title>new items | Crate & Kids</title> (lowercase 'new items', Crate & Kids branding) and embedded digitalData department codes 60/61, distinct from the main New Arrivals department. This was recorded as the Crate & Kids New Arrivals sibling (matching the department-split pattern already established for Bestsellers/Kids Best Sellers and Clearance/Kids Clearance on this site), but the Kids-department attribution is inferred from the title tag and department codes rather than confirmed via a Kids-specific 'New Arrivals' nav link (not found/opened before the block) - flagged for confirmation. /whats-new/new-bestsellers/1, found in the sitemap under the /whats-new/ path, was left out entirely (not opened, and its concept is ambiguous between New Arrivals and Bestsellers) - also noted in the Bestsellers file's notes for the same reason.
